overview: Bongly is a static landing page for a privacy-first indie app studio focused on West Bengal. It features the Chalok transport directory app, blog section, and a clean privacy-focused design with Soft UI base, Glass morphism highlights, and Neumorphism interactions.
features: Soft UI base with pastel palette and gentle shadows
Glass morphism frosted cards with backdrop blur
Neumorphism raised/pressed button and card interactions
Chalok app card with animated glowing border
